title: Lead Test Engineer
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
Join ING as a Lead Test Engineer (End-to-End) and be part of the Pega COE Area, where you will play a key role in owning and executing the full testing cycle—from reviewing requirements and writing test cases to running tests across environments and supporting defect resolution. You will work closely with Agile teams to ensure delivery of high-quality document management or digital signature solutions.
Define and drive the overall testing strategy and quality goals across projects.
Mentor and guide test engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align testing efforts with business objectives.
Own and manage the entire testing lifecycle including functional and integration testing
Collaborate with PEGA engineers and Product Owner / Customer Journey Experts (CJE) to review requirements and create test cases
Execute manual and automated test cases across multiple environments
Identify, track, and manage defects to resolution
Leverage test automation tools and frameworks to improve efficiency
Foster a proactive mindset and effective collaboration within Agile teams
Support continuous improvement in testing practices and processes
Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing within the team
Key Capabilities/Experience
Leadership & Strategy :Establish and lead the overarching testing strategy and quality objectives across multiple projects. Provide mentorship and guidance to test engineers, cultivating a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in quality assurance.
Testing Expertise: Strong experience in functional and integration testing
Test Automation: Familiarity with automation tools and frameworks
Agile Experience: Comfortable working in Agile software development teams
Proactiveness: Demonstrates initiative and ownership in driving quality outcomes
Collaboration:Excellent teamwork and communication skills across stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align testing efforts with business objectives.
Domain Knowledge: Experience in document management or digital signature solutions is a plus
Minimum Qualifications
Educational Background:Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience:Minimum of 7 years of work experience on the related role with at least 2 yrs in leadership role.
Testing Tools:Selenium, Postman or other similar frameworks.
Agile Practices:Understanding of Agile principles and testing methodologies
Communication Skills:Ability to communicate test results and quality concerns effectively
Familiarity toPEGA systemsis a plus
